info.title: RDG API
info.summary: Manage rule-based group definitions, settings, runs and approvals.
info.description:
Served by the Function App linked to the Static Web App. Every call goes through the
Static Web App, which signs the user in (Entra) and forwards the principal in the
`x-ms-client-principal` header; direct calls to the Function App are refused.

Roles: `reader` may call every GET endpoint plus `POST /rules/validate` and `POST /preview`.
Everything else needs `admin`. The API checks the role again on every endpoint.

The API never changes group members. It stores configuration, checks rules with the
engine module and starts runbook jobs.

Errors use RFC 9457 problem details (`application/problem+json`).
All times are UTC, ISO 8601. Lists are paged with an opaque `continuationToken`.

get.summary: Signed-in user, roles and installation mode
get.description: Used by the web app on start, e.g. to show the read-only banner and hide edit controls for readers.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive match on name and target group display name.

post.description:
Validates the rule with the engine module. `target.mode = adopt` starts the adoption:
the engine runs a forced dry run and waits for approval. Writes an audit record in the
same transactional batch.

delete.description:
Releases the target group unchanged; never deletes the group. Audit records stay until
they expire. If other definitions reference this one's group in a memberOf rule, the
API refuses with 409 and lists them, unless `force=true`.

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: Delete even though other definitions reference this one.

post.description:
Records a sync request on the definition (with audit) and starts a job of the matching
runbook. If the job can't be started, the request stays and the next scheduled run
handles it. Repeated calls within one minute return the existing request.
The web app polls the definition until `status.handledSyncRequestAt` reaches `requestedAt`.

post.summary: One-time approval of a blocked change or an adoption
post.description:
Approves exactly the diff identified by `diffHash` (from `status.pendingApproval`). The next
run writes it; a different diff needs a new approval. Refused with 409 when nothing waits
for approval, the hash no longer matches, or the installation is read-only.

get.summary: Run records of one definition, newest first (30 days)

post.description:
Parses the rule with the engine module and returns every error with its position.
Called by the editor 400 ms after typing stops. No Graph calls except checking that
group IDs used in memberOf exist. Always 200; the result says whether the rule is valid.

post.summary: Members a definition would have now

put.summary: Update organisation settings (including the pause switch)

parameters.name: by
parameters.description: UPN of the person who made the change.

get.summary: Group picker (target, adopt, compare group, memberOf)
get.description: Includes the flags the pickers need to disable groups RDG can't manage.
Returns only the version and "ok", no data. Used by the pipeline's smoke test.

post.summary: Roles source for Static Web Apps (internal)
post.description:
Called by the Static Web App after sign-in (`rolesSource` in staticwebapp.config.json), not
by the web app. Turns the token's `roles` claim (Entra app roles Admin, Reader) into the
Static Web Apps roles `admin` and `reader`. Not one of the 18 user-facing endpoints.

200.description: Roles for this user (may be empty)

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: ETag from the last GET. Missing → 428; outdated → 412.

ContinuationToken.name: continuationToken
ContinuationToken.description: Opaque token from the previous page. Pages hold up to 50 items.

Search.name: search
Search.description: At least 2 characters; matches display name, UPN or mail by prefix.

ETag.description: Version of the returned document, for If-Match on the next write.

Forbidden.description: The user's role doesn't allow this

Conflict.description:
The request conflicts with current state: target group already linked to another
definition, definition referenced by others (delete), nothing to approve or hash
mismatch (approve), read-only installation (approve, sync of a create/adopt).

PreconditionFailed.description: ETag mismatch; someone else changed the document. Carries who changed it last.

TooManyRequests.description: Graph throttled the request; retry after the given seconds

upn.description: From the Static Web App principal (userDetails).

mode.description: create = RDG creates the group; existing = a group RDG already owns; adopt = take over a group that exists outside RDG.

groupId.description: Required for existing and adopt; set by the API from status for create once the group exists.

convertFromDynamic.description: Set by the API when the adopted group is a Microsoft dynamic group.

DefinitionFields.description: Fields of a definition that IT sets. Not used on its own; see DefinitionInput and Definition.

DefinitionInput.description: Request body for create and update.

Status.description: Written by the engine; read-only for the API and the web app.

Definition.description: A definition as stored, merged with the engine's status (null before the first run).

etag.description: Same value as the ETag header; lets list rows be edited.

includeUsers.description: Only on GET /definitions/{id}: the users of includeUserIds with their names (users that no longer exist are left out). Missing when Graph couldn't be read.

excludeUsers.description: Only on GET /definitions/{id}: the users of excludeUserIds with their names, as includeUsers.

compareGroup.description: Only on GET /definitions/{id}: name of the compare group.

jobStarted.description: false = the next scheduled run picks up the request.

existingRequest.description: true = a request from the last minute was returned instead of starting another job.

jobUrl.description: Link to the Automation job in the Azure portal.

then.description: Dry runs only: what a real run would have done (read-write access, dry run off).

position.description: 0-based character offset in the rule text.

suggestion.description: e.g. the property name that was probably meant.

PreviewInput.description: definitionId alone previews the saved definition, definition alone a new, unsaved one. Both together preview unsaved changes to a saved definition: the edited version replaces the saved one for this preview.

excludedCounts.description: Complete counts per reason; the excluded list stops at 200 entries.

emptyResult.description: The sync blocks a result that would empty a group with members, unless the definition allows it.

diff.description: Against the current target group; null for a group that doesn't exist yet.

memberCount.description: null when Graph didn't return a count.

membershipRule.description: Rule text of a Microsoft dynamic group, used to pre-fill an adoption.

linkedToName.description: Name of the definition that already manages it.

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem details, extended with RDG fields.

current.description: On 412, who changed the document last and its current ETag.

referencedBy.description: On 409 for delete, the definitions whose rules reference this one.
